Network connectivity check. Use your own tools: your web search / web fetch tools if you have them, otherwise the shell. Do every step, and report the exact result or the exact error. Never guess.
1. Web search: search the web for "octocat Hello-World repository" and give the first result's URL. Say which tool you used; if you have no web search tool, say so.
2. Web fetch: fetch https://example.com/ with your web fetch tool (or curl if you have none) and quote the text of its <h1>.
3. Shell: run `git ls-remote https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World HEAD` and report the commit hash.
4. Shell: run `curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World` and report its "full_name" field.
5. Shell: run `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page` and report the code.
End with a table: step | tool used | succeeded (yes/no) | evidence.
